subject: general
question: Which of the following dance forms is associated with Sikkim?
solution:
• **Tashi Sabdo**: It is the dance form associated with Sikkim. It is a folk dance performed during festivals and celebrations. The dance involves graceful movements and is accompanied by traditional music. Tashi Sabdo is an important part of Sikkimese culture and is performed by both men and women.
